western: COMEX gold front month (Yahoo Finance), adjusted to spot for carry with the 13-week T-bill rate
method: History (backfilled 4 Oct 2026): SGE Shanghai Gold Benchmark PM (14:15 Beijing, 06:15 UTC) converted at USD/CNY, minus the COMEX front-month gold price turned into a spot estimate by removing carry. From May 2024 the Western price and USD/CNY are the 06:00 UTC hourly opens, 15 minutes before the benchmark; before that the daily open (about 22:00 UTC the evening before) is used and the series is shown weekly because of the time gap. Live readings from 8 Oct 2026: SGE PM benchmark against MetalCharts live spot and USD/CNY at run time.
